dialogues.speaker: Zhang Shun
dialogues.text: I heard that Captain Beidou took up some salvaging work recently. I wonder what treasures she'll dredge up this time...

dialogues.speaker: Zhang Shun
dialogues.text: But since it's work from the Qixing, I doubt any of those treasures will ever find their way to me anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Zhang Shun
dialogues.text: Still, I've got quite a few rare items that you can hardly find on land. Care to have a look?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about your battle trophies.

dialogues.speaker: Zhang Shun
dialogues.text: Of all of them, this cup here is probably the one I'll never forget. Brings back memories of my drinking days.

dialogues.speaker: Zhang Shun
dialogues.text: ...But to be honest, now that I've decided to settle down and have a normal life, having it around only makes me sad that those days are over, which doesn't really help me move on.

dialogues.speaker: Zhang Shun
dialogues.text: Thanks for listening to me for so long. Actually, why don't I give this to you? Maybe it'll come in handy on one of your adventures.

dialogues.speaker: Zhang Shun
dialogues.text: What do you think of my wares, friend? Rare things to see on dry land.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just where are these things from exactly?

dialogues.speaker: Zhang Shun
dialogues.text: What? You think they're stolen?

dialogues.speaker: Zhang Shun
dialogues.text: Of course not, I'm a sailor with The Crux. They're the spoils of years of service.

dialogues.speaker: Zhang Shun
dialogues.text: But I got injured during the battle against Haishan. If it weren't for Captain Beidou, I'd be a goner.

dialogues.speaker: Zhang Shun
dialogues.text: So I decided it best I leave The Crux. Can't have a crewmate's old injury flaring up and dragging the crew under...

dialogues.speaker: Zhang Shun
dialogues.text: At least the things I collected over the years is enough to keep me going though.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Rex Lapis' death...

dialogues.speaker: Zhang Shun
dialogues.text: Aye... In my many years spent sailing the open ocean, Captain Beidou took great delight in telling us many a tale of Rex Lapis' many feats.

dialogues.speaker: Zhang Shun
dialogues.text: If Captain Beidou is the star that guides us in the night sky, then Rex Lapis is what keeps the whole sky up in place.

dialogues.speaker: Zhang Shun
dialogues.text: I always said that I would see a Rite of Descension if I returned to land. I never thought...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No need.

dialogues.speaker: Zhang Shun
dialogues.text: Nothing takes your interest? Travel well.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Got anything good in?

dialogues.speaker: Zhang Shun
dialogues.text: Every last item is a keepsake from a voyage across the oceans. Genuine goods at honest prices!
